label: Business Strategy Team
blurb: A Chief Strategy Officer and 4 specialists who turn business goals into a prioritized strategy and execution roadmap
purpose: Designed for business owners, leaders, and teams executing on business strategy. Turn business goals into a prioritized strategy and execution roadmap. The team coordinates research, analysis, operational planning, and structured deliverables to drive measurable results.
